goal.title: The goal
goal.body: You are dropped somewhere in the Pokémon world and shown only a screenshot. Work out where it is, drop a pin on the map and press Guess.

scoring.title: Scoring
scoring.body: Up to {max} points a round: the closer your pin, the more you score. A game is {lengths} rounds; the Daily is always {daily}.

modes.title: Modes
modes.body: Daily: the same {daily} places for everyone. Streak: keep naming places until a pin misses. Play the world, a region or a themed map, with Classic 2D or Modern 3D games.

duels.title: Duels
duels.body: Face a friend live. HP battle: you both start with {hp} HP and the closer pin damages the other. Points race: the best total over the rounds wins.

demo.label: Demo: a Pokémon screenshot appears, a cursor moves to the map, zooms in and drops a pin, presses Guess, a line shows the real spot and the round scores {score} of {max}
